raw_segments.text: You know, when I read about that Jew I shook with sobs all night.
I kept fancying how the little thing cried and moaned, a child of four years old understands,
And all the while the thought of pineapple compote haunted me.
In the morning I wrote a letter to a certain person, begging him particularly to come and
He came and I suddenly told him all about the child and the pineapple compote.
All about it all, and said that it was nice.
He laughed and said it really was nice.
Then he got up and went away.
He was only here five minutes.
Tell me, tell me, Alyosha, did he despise me or not?
She sat up on the couch with flashing eyes.
